item.name: Runs a new instant test based on the POST data.

request.name: Runs a new instant test based on the POST data.

description.content:
Use the onDemand parameter to run from public nodes. An instant test can run from up to five nodes.

**Request:**

The request body must include all required test properties and may include any optional properties as well. By default, the endpoint only allows instant tests to run from enterprise nodes.

To get a sample payload, refer InternalLink[Instant Test Configuration Endpoint,operations-tag-InstantTest,operations-InstantTest-get_v2_instanttests_configuration__instantTestId_].

**Response:**

The response does not include instant test results. To get the instant test results use InternalLink[Instant Test Results Endpoint,operations-tag-InstantTest,operations-InstantTest-get_v2_instanttests__instantTestId_].

item.name: Returns properties of one instant test based on instant test ID.

request.name: Returns properties of one instant test based on instant test ID.

description.content: Results include all the properties set in the instant test during creation. The response from this request can be used to trigger new instant test runs using the POST method.

variable.description: (Required) Instant test ID to look up the test results. Pass “0” to get post data for creating a new instant test.

response.name: Success

item.name: Return instant test results performance data based on an instant test ID and node ID.

request.name: Return instant test results performance data based on an instant test ID and node ID.

description.content:
*[Analytics Endpoint]*

Performance data is for one node and a single step. To get transactions data with multiple steps, use the parameter step ID. If no step ID is passed, the endpoint pulls data for the first step.

The endpoint pulls all the instant test result details seen in the Catchpoint portal. This includes test run details, summary metrics, waterfall details, hosts, zones, and content type. This also includes a public link to the instant test run, screenshot, filmstrip, and request/response headers for each request from waterfall.

query.description: (Required) Node ID to look up the test results
Step ID to look up the test results

variable.description: (Required) Instant test ID to look up the test results

response.name: Success
